transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’m here because I have a hard time sitting still. Like in staff meetings, or church briefings, I feel this motor going under my skin, and I end up shifting around or standing up, finding some reason to move. It’s been getting in the way.
Do you find yourself feeling this need to move in most situations, or is it mainly in meetings and briefings like you mentioned?

It’s… not just meetings. At work I’m kind of always moving—mopping, then checking trash, then fixing chairs, just going from one thing to the next. Even at home, I’ll end up in the garage messing with tools instead of sitting down.
Do you feel anxious or restless when you're unable to move around?

Yeah… restless, mostly. I don’t know if I’d call it anxious exactly, but when I’m supposed to sit still, it feels like this motor’s running under my skin. I start shifting around, or I’ll stand up if I can, or find some reason to move.
Do you have trouble paying attention to details or following through on instructions?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I can follow instructions okay most of the time, I think. Details… maybe I miss things here and there, but I haven’t really noticed that as the main problem.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?

Yeah… sometimes. Like if my supervisor, or someone at church, is telling me what to do, I’ll kind of jump in before they’re done—like I think I already know what they’re going to say. Sometimes I’m wrong, and then they have to correct me.
Do you have trouble organizing tasks and activities?
I don’t know… not especially, I guess. I usually just do what needs doing. I haven’t really thought of organizing as a big issue.
Do you often find yourself talking a lot more than others in social situations?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed that. I’m not usually trying to be the one talking the most.
Did you have trouble sitting still or paying attention when you were a kid?

Yeah… I think so. In grade school I’d get in trouble for getting out of my seat, talking over the teacher, that kind of thing. I’d rush ahead before they finished giving directions. My mom used to say I was kind of… wound too tight, even back then.
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking?
Yeah… sometimes. Like if my supervisor or someone at church is giving me instructions, I’ll jump in because I think I know what they’re about to say. Then I’m wrong, and they have to correct me.
Have your difficulties with sitting still and impulsivity caused problems for you at work, with friends, or in other parts of your life?

Yeah… mostly at work. I’ll miss part of what someone told me, or jump ahead, and then during room turnovers or deciding supplies it causes problems. People get irritated, and my supervisor’s had to correct me a few times. He actually suggested I talk to the employee assistance program, so… yeah, it’s been an issue.
Do you often forget things you're supposed to do, like appointments or tasks?
I don’t know… not especially. I mean, everybody forgets things now and then, but I wouldn’t say that’s the main problem for me.
Do you have trouble completing tasks or projects because you lose focus or get distracted?
Not really, no. I mean… I can get sidetracked like anyone, but I wouldn’t say I have a big problem finishing things because of that.
Do you often struggle to focus on one thing for a long time, like when reading or listening to someone talk?
I’m not sure I’d say often. Reading, maybe I don’t do a ton of it anyway, but listening… I can follow along most of the time. I haven’t really noticed that as a major thing.
Were you more active or fidgety than your siblings or peers when you were a child?

Yeah… I think so. I remember in grade school getting in trouble for jumping out of my seat, talking over the teacher, that kind of thing. My mom used to say I was like… wound too tight, even back then.
Do you have difficulty sustaining focus during tasks that require mental effort, like paperwork or complex cleaning tasks?
I don’t know… paperwork’s not really something I do a lot of. With cleaning, if it’s complicated, I might have to think it through, but I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed a focus problem exactly.
Do you often make careless mistakes when doing tasks?
Not really sure. I mean, everybody slips up now and then, but I can’t say I’ve noticed it happening a lot.
Have you experienced these symptoms of restlessness and impulsivity for as long as you can remember, even as a young child?

Yeah… I’d say so. I mean, even in grade school I was getting in trouble for popping up out of my seat, talking over the teacher, rushing ahead before they finished telling us what to do. My mom used to say I was wound too tight, even back then.
Do you often have difficulty following through on instructions or finishing tasks because you lose interest or get distracted?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I finish what I need to most of the time. I don’t know if it’s from losing interest or getting distracted… I haven’t paid that much attention to it.
Do you often have trouble paying attention to details or making careless mistakes in your daily activities?
I don’t know… not that I’ve really noticed. I mean, I make mistakes sometimes, sure, but I wouldn’t say details are a big problem for me.
Do you often struggle to focus on quiet, leisure activities like reading or watching a movie?

Yeah… quiet stuff can be hard. Like even fishing with my wife, or sitting through bingo, I’ll catch myself tapping or messing with my tackle box or pencil. Sometimes I talk louder than I mean to. It’s just hard to sit there and be still, I guess.
